subject: Next steps: trial infra choice + onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Li <amanda@novamed.ai>, Chris Porter <cporter@novamed.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + infra options for NovaMed POC (success criteria & next steps)

Hi Amanda / Chris —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we all have the same expectations going into the trial:

Proposed success criteria (what NovaMed will validate during the POC):
- Functional: Redwood API processes representative clinical-summary prompts and returns structured outputs matching your schema (FHIR-lite) with >=85% entity extraction precision on sample set.
- Performance: median latency < 200ms and P95 < 600ms for 512-token inference in the target region under expected concurrency profile.
- Cost / throughput: sustained throughput target of ~10 rps for the interactive UI flows with room to scale.
- Security: logs/audit stream available; SOC2-aligned controls; data isolation for PHI in VPC path.

Environment options (tradeoffs):
1) Hosted trial (fastest): Redwood hosted API + scoped test dataset. Best for rapid functional validation and iteration. No customer-managed network setup required.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity): Isolated GPU pool in Redwood tenancy, faster cold-starts and stable performance. Good middle ground if you need an isolated tenancy but not full VPC. Spin-up ~3 business days.
3) VPC trial (customer-managed networking): Full network isolation, data egress control, KMS integration. Required if NovaMed needs on-net-only access or stricter residency/audit controls. Longer setup 1–2 weeks depending on networking and certs.

Recommended approach (we propose a two-track path):
- Track A (short): Start Hosted trial right away to validate functional success criteria and integrate with the UI (2 weeks).
- Track B (parallel): Begin VPC readiness (network configs, certs, KMS details). If VPC is required, transition to VPC trial by week 3.

Immediate asks from NovaMed to proceed:
- Confirm which environment you prefer to prioritize (Hosted first + VPC later vs direct VPC).
- Provide network contact and a point person for security requirements (who will own firewall/whitelists).
- Share a small representative sample (redacted) for the entity extraction check (up to 500 short records).

Owners & timeline (proposed):
- Sales / timeline owner: Diego Fernandez (redwood) — milestone coordination.
- Infra lead: Ben Carter (redwood) — dedicated sandbox/VPC setup.
- CS / success manager: Marissa Cole (redwood) — eval and Q&A.
- Security / compliance: Neha Kapoor (redwood) — questionnaire and logs.

Milestones:
- Decision on infra preference due: 2026-09-03 (EOD).
- Hosted trial start (if agreed): target 2026-09-01.
- VPC readiness checklist complete: 2026-09-03.
- Full POC end: 4 weeks after hosted start.

I've attached a one-page onboarding checklist and a starter network diagram. If you want us to fast-track a dedicated sandbox instead of Hosted, tell us and Ben will start provisioning.

Next steps: Please reply with preferred infra path and your network/security contact. I can send a DocuSign SOW for the sandbox commitment if you want guaranteed capacity.

Best,
Diego
Director, Commercial — Redwood Inference
From: Amanda Li <amanda@novamed.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Porter <cporter@novamed.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 15:38:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + infra options for NovaMed POC (success criteria & next steps)

Diego — thanks for the clear write-up. Chris and I reviewed and we agree with the success criteria. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- We are leaning toward the VPC path due to PHI handling and our internal audit, but we still want to do a quick hosted smoke test to validate the integration.
- Can you confirm what audit/log exports Redwood can provide during the trial? We need at least 90 days of request logs and per-token billing breakdown for the trial.
- Timeline: the Audit team is strict — 2026-09-03 for the readiness checklist is tight but doable if we get the exact network requirements now.

Network/security contact for NovaMed:
- Chris Porter (cporter@novamed.ai), Network Engineer, will own firewall/IP whitelists and certs.

Attached: our security questions PDF and a short list of required compliance artifacts. Also, does Redwood offer a temporary dedicated sandbox while the VPC gets stood up? That would help keep momentum.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Amanda Li <amanda@novamed.ai>, Chris Porter <cporter@novamed.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + infra options for NovaMed POC (technical clarifications and lead times)

Amanda / Chris / team — quick technical notes and realistic lead times from infra: 

1) Audit/log exports: we can stream request logs to your Splunk or S3 bucket (TLS). Default retention for a trial is 90 days; per-token billing breakout is included in the usage CSV. Neha, I'll coordinate the schema for logs.

2) Dedicated sandbox vs VPC:
- Dedicated sandbox (Redwood tenancy): ~3 business days to provision, gives isolated capacity and predictable performance. No inbound VPN required; we give static egress IPs for whitelisting.
- VPC trial: requires customer side firewall rules, optional VPN (or peering), KMS key exchange for encryption-at-rest. Plan for 7–10 business days in typical cases (depends on network ticket velocity).

3) Network requirements (summary):
- Outbound https to api.redwood.ai on 443 (TLS1.2+).
- If you choose VPC/peering: allow inbound from Redwood-managed egress blocks: 34.120.10.0/24, 35.182.55.0/24 (we'll provide final list via secure channel).
- mTLS for control plane optional; public certs OK for the hosted/dedicated options.

4) Data for functional validation: send a 200–500 record set (redacted PHI) or we can use synthetic data. If you send real samples, we will run them only in the agreed trial tenancy and purge after the POC unless you instruct otherwise.

5) Timeline suggestion (practical):
- If you want a Hosted smoke test first: we can hand you credentials and a test dataset by 2026-09-01 (48–72 hours).
- Dedicated sandbox: provisioned by 2026-09-03 if approved today.
- VPC trial: target readiness 2026-09-10 (best estimate) — depends on cert exchange and internal ticketing.

I've attached an updated network diagram and the provisioning checklist. I'll open a ticket with infra to reserve a sandbox slot pending your confirmation.

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Amanda / Chris — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping Chris in. Confirming the plan below so we can all act on the same timeline: 

Agreed plan (two-track):
- Track A (short hosted smoke): Redwood provides hosted test credentials and a sandbox dataset by 2026-09-01. Owner: Ben / Marissa (Redwood). Purpose: rapid functional validation and UI integration.
- Track B (VPC readiness): NovaMed to provide security questionnaire answers + network owner's availability (Chris). Reducing blockers: provide target S3 bucket or Splunk endpoint for logs and the KMS contact. Owner: Chris (NovaMed) + Ben/Neha (Redwood). Target checklist complete: 2026-09-03.
- If NovaMed confirms dedicated sandbox instead of hosted, Ben will provision by 2026-09-03.

Action items (short):
- Amanda/Chris: confirm whether you want Hosted-first or direct Dedicated sandbox (reply by 2026-09-03). Also share the 200–500 sample records (or confirm synthetic).
- Chris: we'll send the definitive egress IP block and a final network diagram over the secure channel today.
- Ben: reserve a dedicated sandbox slot as a backup; share credentials for hosted smoke test by 09/01.
- Marissa: prepare evaluation checklist for the 2-week hosted run and invite NovaMed to the trial dashboard.
- Neha: I'll loop you into the security questionnaire response thread after Amanda shares the PDF.

I will create a short SOW (DocuSign) if you want Redwood to reserve the dedicated sandbox capacity. Otherwise we'll proceed hosted-first and run the VPC prep in parallel.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the DocuSign link and the shared Drive folder for artifacts.

Diego Fernandez
Director, Commercial — Redwood Inference
